# SealedSet

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class SealedSet : LoadedSet
```

A Set that came out of a seal, carrying the seal's own header alongside it.

## Remarks

A [`LoadedSet`](Nfty.Core.Output.LoadedSet.md) with the header attached rather than a separate return value, because every screen that shows a sealed Set has to show what it is allowed to do with it — and a policy the caller has to remember to carry alongside the data is a policy that will eventually be dropped on the way to the one place that checks it.
